info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Currency Exchange Rate Management API
info.description: This API facilitates the management of currency exchange rates within the banking consumer services. It allows authorized users to update exchange rates for various currency pairs, helping ensure that the latest rates are reflected for customer transactions. Typical consumers include financial institutions and fintech applications that require accurate and up-to-date currency exchange information for their operations. This robust functionality supports efficient currency management, enabling businesses to provide competitive services in a dynamic market.
